Internal token symbol string, set once in constructor and read by symbol().
Internal token decimals (18), read by decimals().
Immutable-style total supply, assigned in constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of holder address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount; mutated by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
Constructor: initializes metadata and mints the entire supply to msg.sender.
View getter returning _name.
View getter returning _symbol.
View getter returning _decimals.
View getter returning _totalSupply.
ERC20 transfer: checks zero address and balance, then debits sender and credits recipient.
View getter returning balances[owner].
ERC20 transferFrom: validates zero address, balance and allowance before moving tokens and reducing allowance.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] to _value unconditionally.
View getter returning allowed[owner][spender].
Adds _addedValue to the caller's allowance for _spender.
Subtracts _subtractedValue from the caller's allowance, flooring at zero when the subtraction would underflow.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and mint recipient.
State write balances[msg.sender] = SafeMath.sub(balances[msg.sender], _value) executed before the recipient credit.
State write balances[_to] = SafeMath.add(balances[_to], _value) with a user-controlled destination.
State write balances[_from] = SafeMath.sub(balances[_from], _value) using a user-supplied source address.
State write balances[_to] = SafeMath.add(balances[_to], _value) with a user-controlled destination.
State write allowed[_from][msg.sender] = SafeMath.sub(allowed[_from][msg.sender], _value) after the balance moves.
Unconditional allowance overwrite allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value that can create a double-spend window for pre-existing allowances.
State write allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = SafeMath.add(current, _addedValue).
State write allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = SafeMath.sub(oldValue, _subtractedValue) guarded by a manual underflow branch.
Genesis balance write balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply assigning the entire supply to the deployer.

edges.reason: Constructor body executes the genesis balance assignment.
Constructor writes the token name into _name.
Constructor writes the token symbol into _symbol.
Constructor writes the decimals value into _decimals.
Constructor sets _totalSupply used by the minted balance.
_totalSupply flows into the initial balances[msg.sender] assignment.
Deployer identity (msg.sender) receives the entire initial supply, concentrating minted value on the caller.
Genesis mint writes into the balances mapping.
name() returns _name.
symbol() returns _symbol.
decimals() returns _decimals.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply.
transfer() executes the sender debit state write.
transfer() executes the recipient credit state write.
_to parameter participates in the transfer state update path.
_value parameter is subtracted from the sender balance.
_to parameter indexes the credited balance slot.
_value parameter is added to the recipient balance.
msg.sender selects which balance is debited, making the write caller-dependent.
Current sender balance is read before the subtraction (read-modify-write).
Sender debit mutates the balances mapping.
Recipient credit mutates the balances mapping.
Debit precedes credit, leaving an inconsistent intermediate state that is externally revisitable through token callbacks in derived contracts.
transfer() reads and writes the balances mapping.
balanceOf owner parameter keys the balances mapping lookup.
balanceOf returns a value derived from balances.
transferFrom() executes the source debit state write.
transferFrom() executes the destination credit state write.
transferFrom() executes the allowance reduction write.
_from parameter selects the debited balance slot.
_value parameter is subtracted from the source balance.
_to parameter selects the credited balance slot.
_value parameter is added to the destination balance.
_from parameter keys the nested allowance decrement.
_value parameter is subtracted from the allowance.
msg.sender must hold the allowance keyed by allowed[_from][msg.sender], coupling caller identity to the authorization check.
Current allowance is read before being reduced.
Allowance reduction mutates the allowed mapping.
Source debit is applied before destination credit, exposing an inconsistent intermediate balance state.
transferFrom() reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom() reads and writes the allowed mapping.
approve() executes the allowance overwrite.
_spender parameter keys the allowance slot being written.
_value parameter becomes the new allowance amount.
msg.sender is the allowance owner, so only the caller's own allowance entries can be overwritten.
Existing allowance value is overwritten in the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
allowance owner parameter keys the outer mapping.
allowance spender parameter keys the inner mapping.
increaseApproval() executes the allowance increment.
_spender parameter keys the allowance slot being increased.
_addedValue parameter is added to the current allowance.
msg.sender owns the allowance entry that is incremented.
Current allowance is read before being increased.
Increment mutates the allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval() executes the allowance decrement branch.
_spender parameter keys the allowance slot being decreased.
_subtractedValue parameter drives both the branch test and the subtraction.
msg.sender owns the allowance entry that is decreased.
Current allowance is read into oldValue before the update.
Decrement mutates the allowed mapping.
Cached oldValue local drives the underflow comparison in decreaseApproval.

normalization_plan.reason: _to exists only to select the credited balance slot inside transfer, so it should be folded into the recipient credit operation.
_value only parameterizes the debit arithmetic in transfer and has no independent semantic identity.
_from is the source key of the balance debit and the allowance lookup in transferFrom.
_to only selects the destination balance slot credited by transferFrom.
_value drives both the source debit and the allowance reduction in transferFrom.
_spender is solely the inner key of the allowance overwrite performed by approve.
_value is the literal replacement allowance stored by approve.
_owner is only a read key for balances and is meaningful only inside balanceOf.
_owner is an outer lookup key used exclusively by the allowance view function.
_spender is an inner lookup key used exclusively by the allowance view function.
_spender indexes the allowance entry that increaseApproval increments.
_addedValue is the arithmetic operand of the increment and has no standalone role.
_spender indexes the allowance entry that decreaseApproval modifies.
_subtractedValue is the arithmetic operand of the guarded decrement.
oldValue is a temporary cache of the allowance read that feeds the same decrement branch and should be collapsed into it.
